title: Fixed Low Seat and Front Handcrank Tricycle
description: One newly authored complete recumbent handcycle-style static exterior. Two separate rear spoked wheels on a full transverse axle support a long low frame and continuous reclined seat/back shell. A forward single wheel sits in a complete two-cheek fork; above it an independent elevated hand-crank axle carries two full arms and outward grips. A fixed complete loop links the upper crank-disc appearance to a separate lower front-wheel disc. Two forward foot-rest platforms lie beside the front assembly rather than forming pedals at the seat. The whole low-seat, long front reach and elevated hand-drive-to-front-wheel organization is new geometry, not the old four-wheel manual wheelchair with one caster removed or the old stationary exercise-cycle given road wheels. No old visible mesh imported. One model zero scenes; four opaque untextured PBR appearances, metres native Z up and whole horizontal-envelope-centred ground origin on three complete finite tire facets. All parts are one fixed display pose; no steering, rolling, hand propulsion, chain meshing or travel, braking, speed, seating or disability fit, rehabilitation, athletic efficacy, load, manufacture or safety is claimed. No rider, rig, animation or interaction.
